parameters.name: DeployType
parameters.description:
The deployment type of the cluster. Valid values:   
- multiple: multi-IDC deployment   
- single: single-IDC deployment   
- dual: dual-IDC deployment

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description:
The series of the OceanBase cluster. Valid values:    
- normal: Standard Cluster Edition (Cloud Disk). This is the default value.
- normal_ssd: Standard Cluster Edition (Local Disk).
- history: History Database Cluster Edition.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-available-zone --instance-type cluster --series normal --deploy-type multiple --spec oceanbase.cluster.cd8.xlarge --ob-version 3.2.4.4 --cpu-arch x86 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeAvailableZone --region cn-hangzhou --DeployType multiple --Series normal --ObVersion '3.2.4.4' --InstanceType cluster --Spec 'oceanbase.cluster.cd8.xlarge' --CpuArch x86
